name: omariglol
author: Sam Ralial
description: Measure, detect and script LXI instruments from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Click: instrument panel with network detection and script picker. Middle click: measure all. Right click: refresh.

schema.label: CLI binary
schema.description: The omariglol command-line binary to invoke. Defaults to `riglol`, the name the CLI crate builds.

schema.label: Workspace (empty = active)
schema.description: The workspace to measure, by name or id. Leave empty to use the active workspace.

schema.label: Python script (optional)
schema.description: Absolute path to a Python script. When set, the trigger runs the script instead of measuring every instrument. You can also pick one from the panel's NO SCRIPT button.

schema.label: Measurement query override
schema.description: A SCPI query to run on every instrument instead of the per-type default (scope :MEAS:FREQ?, DMM :MEAS:VOLT?, ...).
